resources.string: Hand the frame to someone else. You stay on as an admin.
Got a new frame? Move everything to it with the code it shows.
To leave, first choose who takes over as owner. Removing the frame disconnects it for everyone.
The new owner can do everything, including removing the frame. Admins already manage it, so they’re usually the best choice.
A frame always has an owner. Choose who takes over before you leave.
There’s nobody else on this frame yet. Invite someone first, then make them the owner.
You’re the only one on this frame. Invite someone to take over, or remove the frame instead.
You stay on the frame as an admin.
You leave the frame right after.
%1$s now owns %2$s. You left the frame.
Photos, albums, settings and people all move over. Nobody needs to touch the old frame.
Switch on the new frame and follow its setup until it shows a code.
The new frame becomes %1$s and downloads everything.
The old frame stops working right away and goes back to its setup screen.
The new frame is now %1$s. It’s downloading the photos and will start the slideshow by itself.
